verses.en: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
From the evil of that which He created
verses.pt: Contra o mal daquilo que Ele criou

verses.en: And from the evil of darkness when it settles
verses.pt: E contra o mal da noitequando entenebrece

verses.en: And from the evil of the blowers in knots
verses.pt: E contra o mal das sopradoras dos nós

verses.en: And from the evil of an envier when he envies
verses.pt: E contra o mal do invejoso, quando inveja
